name: LAPL Automotive Limited
about: LAPL Automotive Limited designs, manufactures, and supplies a range of automotive components and accessories under the LAPL brand. Its Lighting segment provides tail lamps, front and rear indicators, reflex reflectors, head lamps, stop lamps, position lamps, reverse lamps, roof lamps, utility lamps, and side lamps. The Mirror segment offers rear view mirrors. The Motor segment includes starter motors, wiper motors, rotors, and magnetos. The Other Components and Accessories segment features hoods, stators, small BLDC fans, and a range of tools and performance accessories, such as USB chargers, bottle holders, soft top canopies, and mobile inverters. The company also provides custom manufacturing, quality testing, technical support, and logistics solutions. Additionally, it also provides services across the product lifecycle, including designing, prototyping, tooling, homologation, assembly, molding, painting and metalizing, as well as validation and testing through its DVVP Lab for automotive requirements. The company caters for automobile OEMs across passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, two wheelers, and electric mobility segment. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Aurangabad, India.
